journey: Create an account
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: New account automatically signs in and displays the correct Dashboard identity. Duplicate/invalid input cases not exercised in this run.

journey: Sign in, resume a session, and sign out
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Wrong password rejected (generic Request failed), sign-in/sign-out/guard and reload session work. Switching B→A without reload exposes B private/unlisted course cards in A My Courses; A profile confirms identity. Reload fetches A correct courses. Query cache is not reset/account-scoped.

journey: Respect ownership and isolate learner data
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Fresh private course/module/list requests deny access (404) and non-owner edit save is rejected. However private course-progress API returns 200, and B can generate one card from A private AI module (200, 8 credits). UI wrongly exposes author controls; /admin redirects with many duplicate denial toasts. Cached cross-account exposure also confirmed in AUTH-02.

journey: Create a manual course with module outlines
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Manual course saved once with two real module outlines; order and course/module links survive reload. Required title was initially disabled. Inputs were prewritten.

journey: Maintain an existing course's outline
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Rename/description/reorder/add/save/delete/save survived reload; original Variables module still shows two cards and 100% quiz. No injected partial-save failure in this walkthrough.

journey: Edit course details and delete an owned course
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Description/difficulty persist after reload; deletion cancel preserved fixture, confirmed delete removed it, old URL shows a recovery state. Only isolated disposable data deleted.

journey: Discover and open accessible courses
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Public course found; private/unlisted fixture courses excluded. No-match search and recovery/filter/sort control work. Only one public fixture means relative ordering across multiple results not validated.

journey: Plan a course with AI assistance
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Planning returned two useful suggestions. Full generation failed twice (HTTP 503 JSON parse errors, 80s batch), consumed 50 credits, saved zero modules. Outline-only batch then reported two created but stored one and corrupted modules.json (12 trailing bytes); Save Changes fails. Generated descriptions lost. Test storage must be repaired to continue.

journey: Write and maintain lesson content
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Markdown headings/list/table/Python block saved and rehydrated in the editor. Save stays in editor with a success toast.

journey: Author a flashcard deck inside a module
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Two manually authored cards persisted in the reordered sequence after save/reload. Incomplete-card validation not exercised.

journey: Author a quiz and answer key
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Two questions, four options each, selected answer key and explanations survived reload. Answer-selection row is a clickable container rather than a semantic radio/button (keyboard risk). Invalid key/removal boundary not tested.

journey: Configure and remove practice
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Python and JavaScript practice configured/tested; language/code survive reload and explicit removal survives reload. Python fixture restored for learner tests.

journey: Generate and refine module activities with AI
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Standalone generation works: 10 cards appended to existing 1, and 5 quiz questions generated; a manual question edit persisted after reload with counts 11/5. Full content generation failed in COURSE-05. Image generation and replacement/cancel variants not fully exercised.

journey: Read a lesson and run embedded examples
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Lesson content/table render and embedded Python example prints 5. Read is recorded on load. Embedded code is read-only; editable reruns are covered in Practice.

journey: Review every flashcard, including the last
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Both cards flipped; final card review can be recorded with Next flashcard disabled. Course summary subsequently confirmed persisted 2/2 deck progress. Card itself is a non-semantic clickable container.

journey: Rate cards and focus on difficulty
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Hard filter persists the selected card after reload; empty Medium filter explains no matches; Unrated and Easy updates work. Rating itself persists; filter selection resets on reload.

journey: Take a quiz, learn from mistakes, and retry
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Unanswered submission disabled; deliberate mixed answers score 50%, correct retry scores 100%, both explanations shown. Latest score persistence checked in course summary. Generate-more not offered for this manual course.

journey: Practice with starter code, feedback, and a solution
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Python runs print 5 then 7 without accumulated output; NameError shown readably, Reset restores starter, Solution reveals print(5). JavaScript tested in author configuration. Long-running termination not tested.

journey: Complete modules and resume the course
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Next completed Variables; Finish completed Functions. Course summary persisted 50% then 100%, two of two modules, cards 2/2 and latest quiz 100%. Empty outline module can be completed, which is consistent with current explicit-completion rule but weak evidence of learning.

journey: Create and edit a goal-based path
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Create/edit description and estimated hours persist after reload; empty path has Add First Course. No share/audience controls in the edit form.

journey: Build a path from existing courses
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Added owned two-module course and another author’s public one-module course; references, authorship/counts persist. Already-added courses are excluded from picker. API fixture setup time is included in wall time but not interaction time.

journey: Reorder, remove courses, and delete a path
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Removal cancel/confirm and re-add work. Dragging the visible grip does not reorder courses; no accessible reorder action. Delete confirmation/cancel works; final deletion deferred to disposable-path check. Follow-up under SHARE-05: disposable path deletion confirmed; source course remained and reuse count decremented.

journey: Select and follow someone else's path
completion_time_note: N/A: blocked
issues: Paths contains My Learning Paths and Create new learning path only. No Discover/shared list, Follow/Select/Unfollow action, or learner enrollment.

journey: Learn through a path and keep summaries accurate
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Following course links and learning works, including JavaScript outputs 5 then 7. Finishing returns to the course; path has no guided continuation or visible aggregate progress. Accurate 2-module/1-module cards observed. Module-count mutation-cache checks not repeated here.

journey: Choose course visibility and let another user study it
completion_time_note: N/A: blocked
issues: Owned course detail and Basic Info/Modules editor expose no visibility/publish/share control. Public discovery/reuse works only after API fixture setup; the author cannot choose sharing in the UI.

journey: Share a course with specific people and revoke access
completion_time_note: N/A: blocked
issues: No recipient selector, grants list, role setting, or revoke-access control. Named-recipient sharing cannot be started.

journey: Share a learning path inside the product
completion_time_note: N/A: blocked
issues: No audience, Share, shared-path discovery, or recipient controls exist in path details/edit. Visibility exists only in API data; complete in-product sharing cannot be performed.

journey: Handle edits, deletion, and revoked course access in reused paths
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Original author rename is reflected in another author’s path after refresh (live reference). Recipient B sees only 1 of 2 referenced courses; inaccessible private course silently omitted, no unavailable/access warning. Public fixture was set via API because sharing/revocation UI is absent.

journey: Show authors how useful their courses are
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Author card shows a reuse number. Adding a second path raised persisted count 1→2, deleting that path returned 2→1 and kept source course. Before reload card stayed at stale 1 after add. No label explaining unit/own-vs-other paths or contribution dashboard. Concurrent counter reconciliation not exercised.

journey: See how often I studied in the last week
completion_time_note: N/A: blocked
issues: Dashboard shows Modules This Week (3) and Total Study Time (0m), but no study-session count for last seven days. Repeated actions/page loads are activities, not a defined session model.

journey: Maintain current and longest study streaks
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Controlled fixture contains three consecutive study dates for repeated study of one module. UI shows Current Streak 1 and Longest Streak 1 while Recent Activity shows the three days. Service derives streak from one latest module timestamp rather than activity history. Midnight/DST and gap boundaries not exercised.

journey: See courses in progress and paths I selected
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: A read-started unfinished AI course appears in Continue Learning while Courses In Progress is 0. Active Paths is 0 despite an owned two-course path; no Selected Paths metric or adoption feature. Existing count definitions do not match requested meanings.

journey: See activity and progress that survive navigation
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Dashboard survives reload with content-read, completion, quiz (50/100%) and flashcard-review activity. Course summary already retained deck 2/2/latest 100% and completion. Count/session/streak semantics require other journeys. Timing covers the reload checkpoint; previous study actions and a later fresh-card/feed check are shared evidence, not a standalone one-second full study loop.

completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark

Connectivity is not sufficient to guarantee a valid artifact. Unconfigured/unreachable server modes not injected.

journey: Handle generation errors, limits, and provider changes
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Malformed/empty structured results caused 503 while debiting 25 credits per failed module. UI shows a generic retry message, no retained draft result or refund explanation. Pending buttons prevented duplicate click. Provider-key/rate-limit cases cannot be tested because provider selection is absent. Follow-up: after standalone cards/quiz reduced balance to 22, Generate All (25) was rejected; draft remained. Screenshot 38 records UI feedback.

journey: Set notification preferences
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Email/daily-quiz toggle changes and phone persist. Invalid text invalid-phone was accepted and saved; no phone-format validation. Toggle buttons lack exposed checked state. Restored synthetic valid-format number. No real email/SMS sent.

journey: Navigate, recover from errors, and use the app on mobile/keyboard
completion_time_note: Observed audit scenario; not human benchmark
issues: Desktop and 390×700 mobile Courses/Settings/Paths/dialog navigation render usable controls; Escape closes dialog and restores focus. Skip-link keyboard activation exercised; full tab-order/screen-reader audit not complete. Non-semantic card flips/answer keys and unannounced toggle states remain accessibility risks. Expected denial/generation errors and admin toast flood are documented, so console is not clean. Viewport emulation cleared.
